title: Expand strict independently dated MVRV public-fork witness ledger without retrofitting historical rows

frozenRequirements.sourceIdentity: Verify Github repository source coinmetrics/data, public, fork, creation and latest push timestamps, exact master HEAD and git tree sha for csv/btc.csv, raw bytes length and SHA1 Git blob.
frozenRequirements.originalSourceCoverage: Prior c7 three forks immutable and inherited by SHA checked report; thirteen additional source snapshots are tested. Several 2018-2019 snapshots are expected no MVRV and count as negative controls.
frozenRequirements.feature: CapMVRVCur traditional MVRV, NOT free-float, requires CapRealUSD>0 and CapMrktCurUSD>0 and math.isclose(MVRV,capMarket/capReal,rel_tol=0.000005,abs_tol=0.000005)
frozenRequirements.observationWindow: Only observations dated Sunday-2 days (Friday UTC) through Sunday-7 days before Sunday 00:00 UTC, if the archived snapshot was independently hosted by the Sunday decision instant.
frozenRequirements.publicWitnessUTC: Max(GitHub repo created_at, pushed_at); NEVER use original commit author clock alone.
frozenRequirements.selection: For multiple as-of valid snapshots, choose the most recent publicWitnessUTC; count multiple fork copies for the SAME Sunday only ONCE. If a snapshot's latest daily row is >7d old, no candidate from that snapshot.
frozenRequirements.interpretation: Strong independently witnessed GitHub public snapshot numeric provenance only; NOT proof of original Coin Metrics provider initial publication clock; not a broad daily PIT feed.
frozenRequirements.conservativeScientificGuard: Do not claim all historical MVRV absent; report strict source coverage evidence; never compare outcomes or model signal here.
frozenRequirements.baseFrozen: Exactly same 684 BTCI v8.17.1 Sunday dates as c6,c7. Preserve all original labels/outcomes, no re-estimation or tuning.
frozenRequirements.negativeResults: Missing metric, absent rows, changed metadata, wrong sha, unreachable source must be reported, not filled or silently substituted. Stop on integrity mismatch; keep verification failure visible.
frozenRequirements.sourceRights: Coin Metrics original data CC BY-NC 4.0; do not rehost bulk raw CSV, keep SHA and per-date metadata only.
frozenRequirements.R2: Write research report+manifest, GET/sha256 read-back, original pinned parents.
